name: fs100
description: FS100 — the FULL FULL stack: a RAG/agent assistant for the "Dev of the future"

scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive --filter "./apps/*" run lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:ai
scripts.lint:ai: uv run --directory apps/ai-service ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/ai-service ruff format --check . && uv run --directory apps/ai-service pyright
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/ai-service ruff format . && uv run --directory apps/ai-service ruff check --fix .
